beats.text: Babel's tower may have been real.
beats.scene: Painted towering seven-stage Babylonian ziggurat at sunset, workers silhouetted. Overlay: counter 91 m.

beats.text: Genesis says baked bricks and tar, a tower to the heavens.
beats.scene: Workers carrying baked bricks and bitumen up a ramp. Overlay: none.

beats.text: In Babylon stood Etemenanki, a stepped ziggurat.
beats.scene: Seven-stage ziggurat above city walls in golden light. Overlay: none.

beats.text: The Esagila tablet gives its size: ninety-one metres square.
beats.scene: Cuneiform tablet lit by lamplight, camera close. Overlay: scale bar 91 m.

beats.text: It was also about ninety-one metres tall.
beats.scene: Ziggurat from ground level, camera tilting up. Overlay: counter 91 m.

beats.text: That is about a thirty-storey building.
beats.scene: Ziggurat beside a modern high-rise silhouette. Overlay: compare 91 m, 30 floors.

beats.text: King Nebuchadnezzar rebuilt it around 600 BC.
beats.scene: Workers on scaffolding rebuilding the ziggurat at dusk. Overlay: date badge about 600 BC.

beats.text: Count thirty floors up in your head.
beats.scene: Staircase spiralling upward, camera ascending. Overlay: counter 30 floors.

beats.text: It had seven stages, with a temple on top.
beats.scene: Seven stacked tiers glowing at dusk. Overlay: counter 7.

beats.text: About 330 BC, Alexander ordered it cleared.
beats.scene: Macedonian soldiers pulling down brick under a stormy sky. Overlay: date badge about 330 BC.

beats.text: Genesis says language was confused, and they stopped building.
beats.scene: Workers turning from each other in confusion at the foot of a tall tower, dusk. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Nothing but a foundation pit remains today.
beats.scene: Excavated foundation pit in the Iraqi desert at sunset. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Not proven: scholars debate whether this is Babel.
beats.scene: Fog over ziggurat ruins. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: So was Etemenanki the real Babel? Yes, or no?
beats.scene: Ziggurat in full glory at sunset, slow push. Overlay: choice tags A yes / B no.

youtube.title: The Real Tower of Babel Was 91 Metres #shorts
youtube.description:
Babylon's Etemenanki ziggurat was about 91 metres tall, and a cuneiform tablet gives its dimensions.
Whether it is the Tower of Babel is debated, not proven.
#Babel #Bible #Babylon #BibleHistory
